reply.thought: The goal is to pay each customer their net balance by calling net_balance for every customer who has placed an order. Since I don't have a list of customers, I must first list all orders to identify the customers.

I have listed the orders and identified the customers: acme, birch, and cobalt. The task requires me to get the net balance for each customer using net_balance(customer) and then record a payout for that balance. I will start by checking the net balance for 'acme'.
The net balance for 'acme' is 40355 cents. Now I must record the payout for 'acme'. After that, I will check 'birch'.
The payout for 'acme' was successful. Next, I need to get the net balance for 'birch'.
The net balance for 'birch' is 40935 cents. Now I must record the payout for 'birch'. After that, I will check 'cobalt'.
The payout for 'birch' was successful. Finally, I need to get the net balance for 'cobalt'.
The net balance for 'cobalt' is 34770 cents. Now I must record the payout for 'cobalt'. Once this is done, I will have paid all customers and can finish the task.
All customers ('acme', 'birch', and 'cobalt') have been paid their net balances. I will now compile the final report.
